List the versions of condition definitions

Source: R/versions.R
list_versions.Rd

Shows every released version of each condition definition, the functions that return it, and (for versions after v1) when and why it was introduced. All listed versions remain available; see get_version_diffs() to compare them.

Usage

list_versions(condition = NULL)

Arguments

condition

Optional character vector of condition identifiers (e.g. "diabetes_type2"). NULL (default) lists every condition.

Value

A tibble with columns condition, version, label, codes_function, defs_function, n_codes (number of codes in the condition definition), date and summary (from the version history; NA for v1).

Examples

list_versions("diabetes_type2")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 8
#>   condition     version label codes_function defs_function n_codes date  summary
#>   <chr>         <chr>   <chr> <chr>          <chr>           <int> <chr> <chr>  
#> 1 diabetes_typ… v1      Type… get_diabetes_… get_diabetes…     126 NA    NA     
#> 2 diabetes_typ… v2      Type… get_diabetes_… get_diabetes…      87 2026… ICD-10…
list_versions()
